name: @veren/im-conversation
description: Use when the IM family needs the durable team-fact store: rooms and members with idempotent joins, messages with room-exclusive server-assigned sequences, monotonic read cursors, and the channel-to-room ingest that turns provider observations into facts; emits im/message-new after every commit so coordination, turn, and channel delivery can each react without touching each other. Pair with @veren/im (core) upstream and @veren/im-coordination/@veren/im-turn downstream.
